def evolved_dxe(logits_local, targets, V_local, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """2-AR distributed CE: max-shift, then fuse sum-exp + target-gather into one REDUCE_SUM."""
    local_max = logits_local.max(dim=-1).values
    global_max = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_MAX, local_max)
    shifted = logits_local - global_max.unsqueeze(-1)
    local_sum_exp = shifted.exp().sum(dim=-1)
    lo, hi = rank * V_local, (rank + 1) * V_local
    target_local = targets - lo
    in_shard = (targets >= lo) & (targets < hi)
    target_local_safe = target_local.clamp(0, V_local - 1)
    local_target = logits_local.gather(1, target_local_safe.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
    local_target = torch.where(in_shard, local_target, torch.zeros_like(local_target))
    stacked = torch.stack([local_sum_exp, local_target], dim=0)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, stacked)
    global_sum_exp = reduced[0]
    global_target = reduced[1]
    log_sum_exp = global_sum_exp.log() + global_max
    return (log_sum_exp - global_target).mean()

def evolved_dxe(logits_local, targets, V_local, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """1-AR distributed CE: local max-shift only, fuse everything into one REDUCE_SUM."""
    # local max shift for stability (per rank, no collective)
    local_max = logits_local.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
    shifted = logits_local - local_max
    local_sum_exp = shifted.exp().sum(dim=-1)  # relative to local_max
    lo, hi = rank * V_local, (rank + 1) * V_local
    target_local = targets - lo
    in_shard = (targets >= lo) & (targets < hi)
    target_local_safe = target_local.clamp(0, V_local - 1)
    local_target = logits_local.gather(1, target_local_safe.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
    local_target = torch.where(in_shard, local_target, torch.zeros_like(local_target))
    # Need global logsumexp = log(sum_r sum_exp_r * exp(local_max_r)).
    # Without global max, reconstruct exp-scaled sum: sum_exp_r * exp(local_max_r)
    lm = local_max.squeeze(-1)
    scaled_sum_exp = local_sum_exp * lm.exp()
    stacked = torch.stack([scaled_sum_exp, local_target], dim=0)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, stacked)
    global_sum_exp = reduced[0]
    global_target = reduced[1]
    log_sum_exp = global_sum_exp.log()
    return (log_sum_exp - global_target).mean()

def evolved_dxe(logits_local, targets, V_local, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """1-AR distributed CE: direct exp, single-compare in_shard, fuse into one REDUCE_SUM."""
    local_sum_exp = logits_local.exp().sum(dim=-1)
    target_local = targets - rank * V_local
    target_local_safe = target_local.clamp(0, V_local - 1)
    in_shard = (target_local_safe == target_local)
    local_target = logits_local.gather(1, target_local_safe.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1)
    local_target = local_target * in_shard.to(local_target.dtype)
    stacked = torch.stack([local_sum_exp, local_target], dim=0)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, stacked)
    return (reduced[0].log() - reduced[1]).mean()

def evolved_dxe(logits_local, targets, V_local, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """1-AR distributed CE: direct exp, single-compare in_shard, fuse into one REDUCE_SUM."""
    local_sum_exp = logits_local.exp().sum(dim=-1)
    target_local = targets - rank * V_local
    target_local_safe = target_local.clamp(0, V_local - 1)
    in_shard = (target_local_safe == target_local).to(logits_local.dtype)
    local_target = logits_local.gather(1, target_local_safe.unsqueeze(1)).squeeze(1) * in_shard
    stacked = torch.stack([local_sum_exp, local_target], dim=0)
    reduced = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, stacked)
    return (reduced[0].log() - reduced[1]).mean()
